Matthew 5:17.definition: to fill up, complete, bring to full expression; to fulfill.
Matthew 5:17.insight: Jesus describes bringing the Law and Prophets to their intended goal, not setting them aside.

Matthew 5:17.definition: to loosen down, demolish, abolish; to destroy.
Matthew 5:17.insight: The word Jesus explicitly denies: he did not come to tear down the Scriptures.

turn the other cheek.definition: to strike with the open hand, to slap, especially a backhanded blow.
turn the other cheek.insight: A backhand to the right cheek was an insult of dishonor more than an act of injury, framing the saying as a response to humiliation.

turn the other cheek.definition: to set oneself against, to resist, to oppose, often in a hostile or violent sense.
turn the other cheek.insight: 'Do not resist' targets repaying evil with evil; it does not command passivity toward injustice.

judge not.definition: to separate, distinguish, decide; to pass judgment on, to condemn or pass sentence.
judge not.insight: The command forbids condemnatory, sentence-passing judgment; it does not forbid the discernment the same Gospel elsewhere commands.

Matthew 7:1.definition: to separate, distinguish, decide; to pass judgment on, to condemn or pass sentence.
Matthew 7:1.insight: The command forbids condemnatory, sentence-passing judgment; it does not forbid the discernment the same Gospel elsewhere commands.

ask and it will be given.definition: to ask, request, beg, call for.
ask and it will be given.insight: The first of three present-tense imperatives (ask, seek, knock) that describe a continuing, persistent posture rather than a single petition.

ask and it will be given.definition: to seek, search for, strive after, desire.
ask and it will be given.insight: Seeking adds effort to asking: the petitioner actively pursues what is requested.

ask and it will be given.definition: to knock, to rap on a door.
ask and it will be given.insight: Knocking pictures persistence at a closed door, completing the escalating image of confident, continuing prayer.

Matthew 7:7.definition: to ask, request, beg, call for.
Matthew 7:7.insight: The first of three present-tense imperatives (ask, seek, knock) that describe a continuing, persistent posture rather than a single petition.

Matthew 7:7.definition: to seek, search for, strive after, desire.
Matthew 7:7.insight: Seeking adds effort to asking: the petitioner actively pursues what is requested.

Matthew 7:7.definition: to knock, to rap on a door.
Matthew 7:7.insight: Knocking pictures persistence at a closed door, completing the escalating image of confident, continuing prayer.

narrow gate.definition: narrow, strait; confined, as a tight passage.
narrow gate.insight: The gate is 'narrow' not to exclude arbitrarily but because the way of discipleship is costly and deliberate.

narrow gate.definition: a gate, especially a large gate of a city or palace.
narrow gate.insight: A gate marks a decisive point of entry; the image sets two gates and two roads as a stark either/or.

Matthew 7:13-14.definition: narrow, strait; confined, as a tight passage.
Matthew 7:13-14.insight: The gate is 'narrow' not to exclude arbitrarily but because the way of discipleship is costly and deliberate.

Matthew 7:13-14.definition: a gate, especially a large gate of a city or palace.
Matthew 7:13-14.insight: A gate marks a decisive point of entry; the image sets two gates and two roads as a stark either/or.

born again.definition: to beget, be born, bring forth, produce.
born again.insight: Jesus speaks of a true origin or begetting, a new birth, not a mere reform of the old life.

born again.definition: from above; from the first; again, anew.
born again.insight: The pivotal double meaning: 'again' and 'from above.' Nicodemus hears 'again' (a second physical birth); Jesus means 'from above' (a birth of the Spirit).

John 3:3.definition: to beget, be born, bring forth, produce.
John 3:3.insight: Jesus speaks of a true origin or begetting, a new birth, not a mere reform of the old life.

John 3:3.definition: from above; from the first; again, anew.
John 3:3.insight: The pivotal double meaning: 'again' and 'from above.' Nicodemus hears 'again' (a second physical birth); Jesus means 'from above' (a birth of the Spirit).

i am the way the truth and the life.definition: a way, road, journey; figuratively, a course of conduct or means of access.
i am the way the truth and the life.insight: Jesus is not merely a guide pointing to a road; he is himself the road of access to the Father.

i am the way the truth and the life.definition: truth, reality, that which is not concealed; truthfulness.
i am the way the truth and the life.insight: Truth here is not an abstract proposition but a person in whom reality is disclosed.

i am the way the truth and the life.definition: life, both physical and, especially in John, the divine, eternal life.
i am the way the truth and the life.insight: In John's Gospel 'life' regularly denotes the eternal life that Jesus both gives and embodies.
